title: The AhR Signaling Mechanism: A Structural Point of View.
authors: Bonati, Laura; Motta, Stefano; Callea, Lara
one_liner_zh: 综述基于结构信息解析AhR配体激活转录机制，涵盖AhR-ARNT与DNA响应元件复合物的同源建模和分子对接，属广义蛋白-DNA互作建模，但非典型TF-DNA特异性结合机制研究，方法以结构预测为主。
abstract: The Aryl hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) is a well-known sensor of xenobiotics; moreover, it is considered a promising drug target as it is involved in the regulation of many patho-physiological processes. For these reasons the study of its ligand-activated transcription mechanism has stimulated several studies for over twenty years. In this review we highlight the key role of molecular structural information in understanding the different steps of the signaling mechanism. The architecture of the AhR cytosolic complex, encompassing the hsp90 chaperone protein and the XAP2 and p23 co-chaperones, has become available in the last year thanks to Cryo-EM experiments. The structure of the AhR ligand-binding (PAS-B) domain has remained elusive for a long time; it has been predicted by homology modelling, based on known PAS systems, and its ligand-bound forms were modelled through ligand molecular docking. Although very recently some structural information on this domain has become available, considerable efforts are still needed to determine the binding geometries of the AhR key ligands by experimental high-resolution studies. On the other hand, the dimeric structure of AhR with the ARNT protein, bound to the specific DNA responsive element, was partially determined by X-ray crystallography and it was completed by homology modelling. On the whole the current structural knowledge of the main protein complexes that form over the AhR mechanism opens the way to confirm and further investigate the main steps of the proposed ligand-activated transcription mechanism of the AhR.
abstract_zh: 芳香烃受体（AhR）是一种公认的外源物传感器；此外，由于它参与许多病理生理过程的调控，被视为一个有前景的药物靶点。因此，对其配体激活转录机制的研究已推动二十多年的多项研究。在本综述中，我们强调分子结构信息在理解信号机制不同步骤中的关键作用。AhR胞质复合物的结构，包括hsp90伴侣蛋白以及XAP2和p23共伴侣蛋白，已于去年通过冷冻电镜（Cryo-EM）实验获得。AhR配体结合（PAS-B）结构域的结构长期以来一直难以捉摸；它已通过基于已知PAS系统的同源建模进行预测，其配体结合形式则通过配体分子对接进行建模。尽管最近对该结构域的一些结构信息已经可用，但仍需大量努力通过实验高分辨率研究来确定AhR关键配体的结合几何结构。另一方面，AhR与ARNT蛋白形成的二聚体结构，结合于特定DNA响应元件，已通过X射线晶体学部分确定，并通过同源建模完成。总体而言，当前对AhR机制中形成的主要蛋白质复合物的结构知识，为确认并进一步研究所提出的AhR配体激活转录机制的主要步骤开辟了道路。
